hero.title: Four plans, the right capacity
hero.lead: No price is calculated per office, store or warehouse: the location of your teams is not a pricing criterion.

page.annualNote: Annual subscriptions for START, BUSINESS and PROFESSIONAL correspond to 12 months of service for the price of 10 months.
page.modulesNote: Each plan includes a number of standard modules. The Sector Engine recommends the most relevant ones for your industry, and you can replace any of them with another compatible standard module at no additional charge, within your plan’s quota.
page.optionalLead: Add sector capabilities, users and integrations where needed.
